about_the_game:
Join an adorable cat companion on a desktop idle fishing adventure! Watch as your feline friend casts its line and collects a wide variety of fish to fill your growing log. Earn money from selling the catch to purchase upgrades and personalize your island with delightful cosmetics. Sit back and enjoy the serene ambiance while your cat does all the fishing!

Log Caught Fish

Keep track of the fish your little cat buddy catches! The size, strength, and quality of each fish play a crucial role in determining its value. Unlock all types of fish to enhance your cat's fishing skills, allowing them to catch higher-quality fish more efficiently.

Decorate your island

Personalize your island by using and unlocking a variety of cosmetics to make it truly yours.

Buy Upgrades

Visit the shop to purchase upgrades that help your cat catch fish more efficiently and with greater ease.

Character Skins

Choose the character that resonates with you the most and fits your style.

  • Processor: Quad Core 2.4GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660

Recommended:
